sentences.en: Hello everybody and welcome back to the Psychology of Your 20s.

sentences.en: the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s and what they mean for our psychology.

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.

sentences.en: It is so great to have you here back for another day, back for another topic.
sentences.zh: 很高兴你能来这里迎接新的一天，探讨新的话题。

sentences.en: Today, we have a very special episode dedicated to dating with intention and finding meaningful connections in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们有一期非常特别的节目，专门探讨在二十岁如何带着目的去约会并寻找有意义的连接。

sentences.en: Being single in our 20s can sometimes feel like an uphill battle or a bit of a minefield.
sentences.zh: 在二十岁单身有时感觉像是一场上坡战，又或者像是在雷区摸索。

sentences.en: Everywhere we look there is someone who comes with baggage or the commitment phobe or they're emotionally unavailable or just not the right fit and I've noticed that it
sentences.zh: 放眼望去，身边的人要么带着各种情感包袱，要么有承诺恐惧症，要么情感上无法投入，或者只是不合适，我发现这

sentences.en: can cause us to become quite cynical and kind of shy away from meeting new people or dating at all.
sentences.zh: 会导致我们变得相当愤世嫉俗，甚至有点抗拒结识新朋友或压根不想约会。

sentences.en: But many of us in this decade are still seeking companionship and more than that we're seeking
sentences.zh: 但在这个十年里，我们中的许多人仍在寻找伴侣，不仅如此，我们还在寻找

sentences.en: partnership and with that comes a more mature approach to dating and dating with intention.
sentences.zh: 伴侣关系，随之而来的便是一种更成熟的约会态度和带着目的去约会。

sentences.en: Dating with intention doesn't mean that every person you go on a date with has to be the one or that you need to be expecting an engagement ring within the first 12 months.
sentences.zh: 带着目的去约会并不意味着你约会的每个人都必须是你的真命天子/真命天女，也不意味着你需要在前12个月内就期待着一枚订婚戒指。

sentences.en: It's more so that you've done the inner work and the inner healing to identify the people and the romantic connections that are going to serve you and make you a better person.
sentences.zh: 更多的是指你已经做了内心建设和心理疗愈，能够识别出那些将对你有所帮助、能让你成为更好的人的对象和浪漫关系。

sentences.en: And maybe that could lead to something bigger.
sentences.zh: 也许这能发展成更大的一段关系。

sentences.en: It's an approach that I've adopted recently.
sentences.zh: 这是我最近才采取的一种方法。

sentences.en: And in the past, I've been really candid with you all before about my very fun and tumultuous dating history from flings to year-long situationships to engaging with people I knew
sentences.zh: 过去，我曾向大家非常坦诚地分享过我那些有趣而又波折的约会历史，从短暂的露水情缘到长达一年的无名分关系，再到与那些明知

sentences.en: weren't good for me and quite honestly it got to the stage that I just didn't have the energy to do that anymore.
sentences.zh: 对我不好的交往对象纠缠不清，说实话，我已经到了这样一种阶段：我真的再也没有精力去那样做了。

sentences.en: It was fun for a while but I value my time and my emotional and mental well-being too much now to kind of entertain these kinds of relationships.
sentences.zh: 这种关系曾经好玩过一阵子，但我现在太珍视自己的时间、情感和心理健康了，不会再去维系这种关系了。

sentences.en: So today I want to share with you how we can date with intention in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我想和大家分享，我们在二十岁时该如何带着目的去约会。

sentences.en: Psychology has a lot to say about this topic as always and it recognizes that our 20s are at this very pivotal stage in our personal and relational development.
sentences.zh: 正如以往一样，心理学对这个话题有很多见解，它认为我们的二十岁是我们个人和人际关系发展的关键阶段。

sentences.en: A lot of the research that we encounter in this area emphasizes the importance of self-awareness and establishing clear goals and values when entering the dating
sentences.zh: 我们在这一领域接触到的大量研究都强调了自我意识的重要性，以及在进入约会

sentences.en: world and it also articulates that by understanding ourselves and our desires we are better able to navigate relationships with greater purpose and authenticity.
sentences.zh: 世界时确立清晰的目标和价值观的重要性，并且它还阐明，通过了解自己和我们的欲望，我们能够以更高的目标感和真实性更好地驾驭人际关系。

sentences.en: Studies have also suggested that I would say in a generation and a modern day that is characterized by a very fast-paced very
sentences.zh: 研究还表明，我想说在一个快节奏、高度

sentences.en: digital approach to dating using apps like Hinge and Tinder making the conscious decision to date
sentences.zh: 数字化的约会时代（使用Hinge和Tinder等应用程序）中，有意识地决定带着目的去约会

sentences.en: with intention can contribute to longer term relationship satisfaction and personal growth.
sentences.zh: 可以促进长期的关系满意度和个人成长。

sentences.en: It encourages us, us in our 20s, to really cultivate emotional intelligence and a willingness to engage in self-reflection and to step beyond our comfort zone.
sentences.zh: 它鼓励我们这些二十岁的人真正培养情商，愿意进行自我反思，并跨出我们的舒适区。

sentences.en: Overall, all of the concepts, all of the articles, all of the research that I've come across demonstrates the value of
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我所接触到的所有概念、所有文章、所有研究都证明了

sentences.en: approaching dating in your 20s with intention because this is what lays the groundwork for healthy relationship patterns and of course personal fulfillment in the future.
sentences.zh: 在二十岁时带着目的去约会是非常有价值的，因为这为未来健康的恋爱模式奠定了基础，当然也为未来的个人成就感奠定了基础。

sentences.en: So today we're going to talk about it from the very practical ways that you can develop your own self-awareness and self-discipline to identify and know what's right for you.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我们将从非常切实的角度来讨论它，教你如何培养自己的自我意识和自律能力，以识别并了解什么才真正适合你。

sentences.en: We're going to talk about understanding the motivations and intentions of others, meeting people organically, and maintaining your authenticity.
sentences.zh: 我们将讨论如何理解他人的动机和意图、自然而然地结识新朋友，以及保持真实的自我。

sentences.en: I'm here for all of it.
sentences.zh: 我举双手赞成这一切。

sentences.en: Without further ado, let's dive into how we can date with intention and form meaningful connections in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 废话不多说，让我们深入探讨如何在二十岁时带着目的去约会并建立有意义的连接。

sentences.en: Dating is fun.
sentences.zh: 约会很有趣。

sentences.en: It's meant to be fun.
sentences.zh: 它本来就该是有趣的。

sentences.en: And in our 20s, it can be particularly exciting.
sentences.zh: 在二十岁的时候，它尤其令人兴奋。

sentences.en: There's all these fish in the sea, as they say, so many options, but sometimes it can also be a challenging experience.
sentences.zh: 正如他们所说，天涯何处无芳草，有这么多的选择，但有时它也可能是一次充满挑战的经历。

sentences.en: I say it all the time, but this decade is a profound period of self-discovery, exploration, and often a time when we seek companionship and genuine connection.
sentences.zh: 我总是这么说，这个十年是一个深刻的自我发现、探索的时期，也往往是我们寻找伴侣和真挚连接的时期。

sentences.en: However, it's important to approach dating with intention, understanding our own desires and goals, and being mindful of the qualities that we seek in a partner.
sentences.zh: 然而，以目的导向的态度去约会是很重要的，要了解我们自己的欲望和目标，并留心我们在伴侣身上寻找的品质。

sentences.en: The truth is that our romantic relationships have a profound impact on our identity, our lives, our self-concept, and psychology acknowledges that our sense of self
sentences.zh: 事实是，我们的恋爱关系对我们的身份、生活、自我概念有着深远的影响，心理学承认我们的自我意识

sentences.en: is shaped through interactions with others.
sentences.zh: 是通过与他人的互动塑造出来的。

sentences.en: And romantic partnerships play a significant role in this process.
sentences.zh: 而恋爱关系在这个过程中扮演着重要角色。

sentences.en: The emotional intimacy and the support offered can foster feelings of acceptance and belonging, which are of course crucial for a positive self-concept.
sentences.zh: 其中提供的情感亲密感和支持可以培养接纳感和归属感，这当然对建立积极的自我概念至关重要。

sentences.en: But when you're in the wrong relationship, when you're wasting your time with someone who doesn't actually care about you
sentences.zh: 但当你处于错误的关系中，当你把时间浪费在一个并不真正在乎你

sentences.en: or doesn't fill your cup up, who doesn't fulfill you, it's also going to carry potential for negative impacts.
sentences.zh: 或者无法滋养你、无法让你感到充实的人身上时，它也会带来潜在的负面影响。

sentences.en: Difficulties or conflicts within a relationship can lead to self-doubt, they can lead to insecurity and a distorted sense of self.
sentences.zh: 关系中的困难或冲突会导致自我怀疑、不安全感和对自我意识的扭曲。

sentences.en: There's also the fact that any relationship but particularly ones with a romantic partner are going to take up a large amount of time and time
sentences.zh: 还有一个事实是，任何关系，尤其是与浪漫伴侣的关系，都会占用大量的时间，而无论在什么年纪，时间

sentences.en: is precious at any age really but especially in this era of our lives when we really have all of
sentences.zh: 都是宝贵的，尤其是在我们生命的这个阶段，当我们真正拥有

sentences.en: these opportunities to go out and make mistakes to explore the world you don't want to feel tied down or held back by someone that you've chosen to be with.

sentences.en: Essentially, that means that we want to make sure we're not investing in a relationship that is taking away from our identity and may
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，这意味着我们要确保自己没有将精力投入到一段会消磨我们身份、并且

sentences.en: inevitably just leave us drained and heartbroken.
sentences.zh: 难免会让我们精疲力竭且心碎的关系中。

sentences.en: Sometimes that's unavoidable.
sentences.zh: 有时这是不可避免的。

sentences.en: Things don't work out for a myriad of reasons.
sentences.zh: 事情由于种种原因而没能如愿。

sentences.en: But I think if you're like me, I've reached a point in my 20s, if not my life in general, whereby I've learned the lessons that I needed to.
sentences.zh: 但我想如果你和我一样，我在二十岁时——如果不是整个人生的话——已经到了这样一个节点：我吸取了自己需要的教训。

sentences.en: I've done it.
sentences.zh: 我都经历过了。

sentences.en: I've had the breakup experience.
sentences.zh: 我经历过分手的痛苦。

sentences.en: I've forced connections that weren't there.
sentences.zh: 我曾勉强维系那些并不存在的连接。

sentences.en: And I'm kind of done with the casual dating life.
sentences.zh: 而我已经有点厌倦这种随意的约会生活了。

sentences.en: I do think there's a time and a place for that.
sentences.zh: 我确实认为那有其时间和地点。

sentences.en: You learn a lot about yourself, you learn what you like.
sentences.zh: 你会从中学到很多关于自己的东西，了解自己喜欢什么。

sentences.en: But I now realize that dating is a time commitment and it takes away energy from the other things that I care about and what I want to be invested in and with that
sentences.zh: 但我现在意识到，约会是一项时间投资，它会分走我对其他我真正在乎的事物以及我想投入精力的东西的热情，伴随于此的

sentences.en: has come a commitment to dating with intention and that doesn't mean that I'm giving up on the
sentences.zh: 是一种对目的导向约会的承诺，这并不意味着我要放弃

sentences.en: occasional casual date or even hookup but it's about being able to recognize that chemistry
sentences.zh: 偶尔的随性约会甚至一夜情，而是要能够认识到化学反应

sentences.en: is not the same as compatibility and setting up healthy boundaries around what you expect from a partner and identifying when someone is bringing that to the table.
sentences.zh: 并不等于契合度，并围绕你对伴侣的期望建立健康的边界，同时识别出当有人符合这些条件时的表现。

sentences.en: So what does it mean to date with intention?
sentences.zh: 那么，带着目的去约会意味着什么呢？

sentences.en: Well, it involves being intentional about our actions and our choices when it comes to our romantic connections.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这涉及到在我们的浪漫关系中对我们的行动和选择保持明确的目的性。

sentences.en: It means taking the time to reflect on our own needs, our own desires and long-term goals before entering into a relationship with our eyes closed.
sentences.zh: 这意味着在盲目地开始一段关系之前，花时间反思我们自己的需求、内心的渴望和长期目标。

sentences.en: When we date with intention, we are more likely to attract partners who align with our values and share our aspirations.
sentences.zh: 当我们带着目的去约会时，我们更有可能吸引到那些与我们的价值观一致并分享我们志向的伴侣。

sentences.en: It's all around, I think, a better deal for everyone involved.
sentences.zh: 总的来说，我认为这对涉及其中的每个人来说都是一笔更好的买卖。

sentences.en: It respects the other person and not wasting their time, but it also shows that you respect yourself because you're
sentences.zh: 这尊重了对方，没有浪费他们的时间，同时也表明你尊重自己，因为你

sentences.en: not going to entertain something that may actually do more harm than good.
sentences.zh: 不会去维系一段可能弊大于利的关系。

sentences.en: So how can we implement this?
sentences.zh: 那么我们该如何落实这一点呢？

sentences.en: There are four critical pillars that are the foundation for dating with intention.
sentences.zh: 有四个至关重要的支柱，它们是带着目的去约会的基石。

sentences.en: The first one is understanding your own values and your own goals.
sentences.zh: 第一点是了解你自己的价值观和目标。

sentences.en: Secondly, setting healthy boundaries, a secret ingredient to all relationships, not just romantic.
sentences.zh: 其次，设定健康的边界，这是所有关系（不仅仅是恋爱关系）的秘诀。

sentences.en: The third is being open to surprises and organic connections and finally maintaining realistic expectations and not getting anxious or desperate if it maybe takes you some time.
sentences.zh: 第三点是对惊喜和自然产生的连接保持开放心态，最后是保持现实的期望，如果花了一些时间，也不要感到焦虑或绝望。

sentences.en: I always say this so I'm sorry if I sound like a broken record but I would much rather be single until I'm in my late 30s or 40s than settle with

sentences.en: I think it's about reminding ourselves that good things take time.

sentences.en: So let's start with how psychology can inform our values and goals around pursuing a romantic connection.

sentences.en: There is of course a lot of science, a lot of psychology that plays a crucial role in understanding our motivations and our behaviors in the dating realm.

sentences.en: Research suggests that having clarity about our own values and goals is key to finding meaningful connections.
sentences.zh: 研究表明，明确我们自己的价值观和目标是寻找有意义的连接的关键。

sentences.en: and have a clear understanding of their values and life goals tend to make more intentional
